execution_model: deterministic local Python; single-process SQLite fencing arm plus synthetic hashed checkpoint-pointer arm

fencing.scenario: B(gen2) commits, then delayed A(gen1) resumes

scope_guard.fencing: Directly tests a deterministic protected-resource generation check in one local SQLite process; it does not reproduce Redis lease expiry, clock skew, GC pauses, network partitions, or distributed database fencing semantics.
scope_guard.cached_latest: Directly tests reconstruction logic over synthetic hashed checkpoint objects; it does not establish that this repository or GitHub serves stale cache entries in production.
